<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 14"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Nourishing Gate](/Feats.aspx?ID=4200) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 23

</column>

---

You can sustain yourself on a single drop of elemental dew or the slightest spark from the [Plane of Fire](/Planes.aspx?ID=6). You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against [poisons](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145), and effects that would make you [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28). You don't need to breathe, eat, or sleep, though you must still take a full night's rest every 24 hours to be able to make your daily preparations. During this time, you remain awake and alert, but you must spend the time meditating or attuning to your kinetic gate rather than engaging in other complex activities. Each kineticist attunes in their own individual way.

<title level="2">Nourishing Gate leads to...</title>
[Elemental Apotheosis](/Feats.aspx?ID=4203)
name: Nourishing Gate
